searchDocuments.title: Tutu for the character The Fairy of Beauty in the Prologue of The Royal Ballet production of 'The Sleeping Beauty' (1968)
searchDocuments.subtitle: Costume Collection | ROH/PRO/COS/0002029 | 1968

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of gold lurex. The central panel is white faux fur decorated with silver sequins, gold flower-shaped sequins, diamanté, silver beads, gold hand-painting, and black diamond-shaped beads to simulate ermine. There is a large rhinestone in the centre of the neckline. The bodice is outlined in white faux fur with black diamond-shapped beads to simulate ermine, and this extends over the shoulder straps. Where the bodice and skirt meet at the sides are strips of silver and black embroidered ribbon, diamanté, and iridescent sequins. There are two poppers at the top of the back for attaching a cloak. The underskirt is layers of mauve net with scalloped edges. The top layer of skirt is gold lamé net decorated with gold sequins. The centre front of the skirt has an appliquéd panel of mauve net decorated with a band of silver ribbon, sequins, and gold braid edging. The skirt is also decorated with crown motifs made of silver braid and diamanté, and butterfly motifs of iridescent crystal organza, gold thread, and pearlised sequins. The bodice has eyelets at the back but the laces are missing.
metadata.Condition: Good.The edge of the skirt is slightly crushed. The eyelets are rusting.
metadata.Creator: Lila de Nobili

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of gold lurex. The centre front has two appliquéd panels. The right panels is crin painted silver with a black-painted pattern decorated with iridescent sequins and rhinestones. The left panel is white crin decorated with gold braid, gold leatherette, iridescent leaf-shaped sequins and circular rhinestones. The right shoulder strap has three tongues of gold-threaded crin decorated with iridescent sequins and beads. Attached to the left shoulder strap, front and back, is a sash of black net over an elastic arm band, decorated with iridescent sequins and diamanté. The oval skirt is layers of cream net. The overskirt of gold lurex is decorated on the back right with an appliquéd panel of gold tulle decorated with gold and iridescent sequins; front right with a panel of white and gold crin decorated with gold cord, gold leatherette and rhinestones; left front with appliquéd stars of gold cord and gold leatherette with rhinestones at the centre; and left back with a panel of black tulle decorated with iridescent sequins and diamanté. There are elastic shoulder straps and an elastic strap in the gusset.
metadata.Condition: Good.The skirt is slightly crushed and dirty.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of red rayon grosgrain decorated with feather-shaped lines of gold cord and hand-painted with a darker red. The central V panel of the bodice is decorated with appliquéd gold and white crin that has been hand-painted in red, and decorated with sequins. The bottom edge of the bodice has scalloped edges overlaying the skirt. The skirt has under layers of nylon net graduating from purple to pale pink. The top layer of the skirt is made of flame-shaped tongues of red, yellow and orange rayon grosgrain, each edged in gold thread, and tongues of gold and white crin. The skirt is also decorated with pink and red feathers, pieces of frayed red and yellow silk, and gold sequins. At the back are wing shapes made of boned panels of gold and white crin hand-painted in pink. Both sides of the centre back bodice and skirt are decorated with a panel of black and gold crin. The bodice has pink elastic shoulder straps and fastens with hooks and eyes. There is an elastic strap in the gusset.
metadata.Condition: Good.The net of the skirt has been significantly trimmed. The skirt is slightly crushed. The gusset has been cut through.
metadata.Creator: Natalia Goncharova

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of salmon-pink polyester. Along the top of the bodice is a draped band which runs across the top of the arms and around to the back. At the centre front of the bodice is a lozenge-shaped decoration with a vertical line of sequins and clear beads surrounded by hand-painted lines. Either side of the decoration is a vertical line of hand-painted Greek key patterns in gold and black. The overskirt of salmon-pink polyester has an opening at the front and is decorated down the two front edges and along the bottom edge with a Greek key pattern. The bottom edge of the overskirt is trimmed with a gold braid fringe partially painted silver. The skirt is layers of white net with scalloped edges. There is an elastic strap in the gusset.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a bodice of black lycra embroidered with black iridescent beads under a layer of black net. It has a deep V at the front infilled with beige elasticated net. The neckline is edged with iridescent black-green feathers, and the bodice is decorated with small black and clear beads, and black and silver sequins. The pink elastic shoulder straps support shoulder caps of loops of small black and clear beads and black sequins. The basque is decorated with black ruched cotton net, silver sequins, black and clear beads and silver sequins painted blue and black which fan out over the skirt to create the impression of feathers. The underskirt is layers of black net with pointed edges. The top layer of soft midnight blue and soft black cotton net is decorated with iridescent black-green feathers and appliquéd black panne velvet feather shapes.
metadata.Creator: Yolanda Sonnabend

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of white satin. The top edge of the bodice is trimmed with silver lace and the bust area is overlaid with white organza and decorated with vertical stripes of diamanté on black cord. The bodice is heavily decorated with appliquéd black and silver braid, black and silver cord, faux pearls and diamanté in diamond and zigzag patterns. The lower edge of the bodice extends over the skirt and is trimmed with a frill of pleated white and silver striped organza. Two upper arm bands, attached to the shoulder straps by elastic, are made of white net decorated with silver lace and silver beads. The skirt is layers of white net with scalloped edges, and a shorter overskirt of silver net decorated with two zigzag lines of black lace and white and silver crin ribbon. The lower line is decorated with rectangular rhinestones.
metadata.Condition: Good.There is some discolouration around the underarms.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of salmon-pink polyester. Along the top of the bodice is a draped band which runs across the top of the arms and around the back. The band is trimmed with a gold braid fringe and is decorated with a Greek key pattern in gold braid outlined in black paint. In the centre of the band and at two points over the arms are clusters of clear gems. There is a left-hand short sleeve of salmon-pink polyester edged in gold braid. The centre front of the bodice has a lozenge-shaped decoration of a vertical line of sequins and clear beads surrounded by gold braid. Either side of the decoration is a vertical line of Greek key patterns on gold braid highlighted with black and white hand-painting. The overskirt of salmon-pink polyester has an opening at the front and is decorated down the two front edges and along the bottom edge with a Greek key pattern. It also has a palm leaf motif in gold braid and gold paint highlighted with white and black hand-painting and silver sequins with small gold beads. The skirt is layers of white net with pointed edges. The top layer of net is sprayed gold at the hem. There are beige elastic shoulder straps.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a pale blue sateen bodice with a collar of white crin and gold metallic ribbon worn off the shoulder. There is a rosette of pink ribbon in the centre front of the collar. It has a central decoration of gold crin and gold sequins, and two gold crin and gold sequin baubles. The centre front of the bodice is decorated with strips of white crin and gold braid in a V shape ending in a point at the waist with two gold baubles. The basque of pale blue sateen is decorated with bows of white crin with gold ribbon, and baubles of silver and gold sequins. The short sleeves of blue sateen are slashed to reveal beige elbow-length net with two rows of crin frills. The tops of the sleeves are decorated with gold bows and gold baubles. The underskirt is layers of lilac nylon net with scalloped edges.The top layer is pale blue chiffon laid over grey and black striped lining fabric, edged in white crin with a gold thread decoration. The skirt is decorated with foliage shapes of white crin and flower shapes of white muslin. There are small elastic shoulder straps, an elastic strap in the gusset, and a hoop in the skirt.

metadata.Description: Tutu of black velvet and silver lurex. The wide shoulder straps are trimmed with silver cord and iridescent sequins. The neckline rises to a point at the centre front and is decorated with iridescent sequins and a band of silver and black lamé with a floral pattern. The centre front black velvet panel is decorated with two lines of silver cord and a rhinestone surrounded by silver braid. The side and back panels are silver and black lamé with a floral pattern. Armbands of black velvet trimmed with silver braid, iridescent sequins and rhinestones are attached to the shoulder straps by strings of diamanté. The skirt is layers of black net with pointed edges. The overskirt is panels of black velvet with silver and black lamé outlined with silver cord and iridescent sequins. At the top and bottom, the panels have a diamond-shaped motif of silver braid and iridescent sequins with a large rhinestone at the centre. Worn with wristbands ROH/PRO/COS/0005571.
metadata.Creator: Barry Kay

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of cream silk. The neckline is edged with a pale blue net frill. The bust area is outlined with alternating diamanté and faux pearls and decorated with coloured faux jewels surrounded by diamanté or pearls. At the centre is a jewel decoration of two square and one lozenge-shaped diamanté surrounded by small round diamanté and with three faux pearl drop beads. The basque has scalloped edges decorated with pearls, and coloured faux jewels surrounded in diamanté or pearls. The underskirt is pale grey net with scalloped edges and the top layer is decorated with silver sequins. The overskirt is pale blue net decorated with silver sequins and sprays of cloth flowers in pink, yellow, blue, white, and rolls of blue crin. There are elastic shoulder straps, an elastic strap in the gusset, and a hoop in the skirt.
metadata.Condition: Good.The knickers have been cut through for exhibition purposes.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of white silk grosgrain hand-painted green. The bust is decorated with a band of pleated pale green nylon net pinned at the centre with a pearlescent faux jewel surrounded by small diamanté and faux pearls. The central panel is decorated with appliquéd white and pale green stars made of painted felt outlined in black pen with a diamanté in the centre. The skirt has underlayers of pale green net with scalloped edges decorated with circular and flower-shaped silver sequins. The skirt is overlaid with swags of yellow-green net caught at intervals with clusters of felt flowers and leaves painted blue and white and joined with wire branches covered with green thread. There are elastic shoulder straps, an elastic strap in the gusset, and a hoop in the skirt.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a black velvet boned bodice. It is decorated at the neckline with an appliquéd motif of gold thread and gold flower-shaped sequins on black net. The motif starts at the left back, runs along the front neckline and continues diagonally down to the left hip and onto the skirt. At the top right of the neckline is a sprig of wire covered in gold and ending in small opalescent pendent faux jewels. The skirt is layers of black net with pointed edges. The decoration is missing from the skirt. There are elastic shoulder straps and a strip of elastic in the gusset.
metadata.Condition: Good.Some crushing of net skirt and there is a tear in the top layer. There is visible corrosion to the metal fastenings and bodice decoration.
metadata.Creator: Leslie Hurry

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of pink panne velvet outlined with ivory velvet decorated with black diamond-shaped beads to simulate ermine. metadata.Description: Tutu with a bodice of salmon pink lurex. The bertha collar is gold-threaded crin decorated with silver embroidery and silver sequins. In the centre of the neckline is a rosette of red cotton organdie ribbon with baubles of white sequins hanging from silver cord. The bodice is decorated with appliquéd motifs of silver embroidery and silver sequins and has a band of silver crin running down the centre. The long sleeves are beige cotton net decorated with silver embroidery and silver sequins. At the tops of the sleeves is a rosette similar to that on the bodice, attached to the collar via elastic. The sleeves have crin cuffs. The skirt is made of layers of pink and orange cotton net with scalloped edges and overlaid with a layer each of salmon lurex and organza. The skirt is decorated with appliquéd silver lurex outlined in silver braid and with silver sequins. There are elastic shoulder straps and an elastic strap in the gusset.
metadata.Creator: Oliver Messel

metadata.Description: Tutu with a bodice of salmon pink lurex overlaid with pink net. The bertha collar is gold-threaded crin decorated with silver embroidery and silver sequins. The bodice is decorated with appliquéd motifs of silver embroidery and silver sequins. There are rosettes of red cotton organdie ribbon at the centre front and at the tops of the sleeves. The bodice has a peplum with an additional lozenge-shape centre front. The long pink net sleeves end in crin cuffs decorated with knots of thread. The skirt is underlayers of pink cotton tarlatan and an overlayer of salmon pink lurex overlaid with pink net with a scalloped edge. The overskirt is decorated with appliquéd shapes of silver braid sewn with silver sequins. The skirt has a metal hoop.

The overskirt is white nylon net over a layer of eau de nil lurex, both with a scalloped edge. The overskirt is decorated with opalescent sequins and leaf shapes. There is an elastic strap in the gusset. Worn with headdress ROH/PRO/COS/0000077.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a bodice of white grosgrain taffeta. The neckline is decorated with a frill of white nylon net with gold thread. The centre front is decorated with silver effect braid, rhinestones, silver and gold effect sequins and simulated lace woven with silver gilt braid in a stylised foliage pattern ending in a point. There are stylised leaf decorations in silver gilt braid on the back. The basque is decorated with silver gilt braid in stylised leaf shapes. There are armlets of white nylon and silk net with scalloped edges. They are decorated with silver and gold sequins and held in place by elasticated white satin ribbon. The skirt is white nylon net with scalloped edges. The overskirt of white silk net has pointed edges and is decorated with silver and gold effect lamé, sequins and braid. There are elastic shoulder straps, an elastic stap in the gusset, and a hoop in the skirt.
metadata.Condition: Good.Gusset has been unstitched for display.
metadata.Creator: Oliver Messel

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of cream cotton sateen overlaid with white cotton organdie. Along the top of the bodice is a draped band of burgundy cotton organdie which runs across the top of the arms and around to the back. The band is trimmed with a black rayon fringe. At the centre of the neckline is a white cotton organdie rose with green cotton leaves. The bodice is decorated with two vertical lines of a floral motif of appliquéd black and pink organdie and mother of pearl sequins. The lines of decoration extend down the two sides of the split overskirt and along its bottom edge. The overskirt is cream cotton sateen overlaid with white cotton organdie. The skirt is layers of white cotton tarlatan with a top layer of white nylon net, all with pointed edges.
metadata.Condition: Good.Soiled and dusty, tarlatan dirty, back seam torn.
metadata.Creator: Robin Ironside

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of red rayon grosgrain decorated with feather-shaped lines of gold cord and hand-painted with a darker red. The central V panel of the bodice is decorated with appliquéd gold and white crin hand-painted with purple. At two points on the neckline are plumes of thin red ostrich feathers. The centre back of the bodice is appliquéd with a panel of dark blue crin. The bottom edge of the bodice has scallop edges which overlay the skirt. The skirt has under layers of tarlatan graduating from pale pink to bright pink. The top layer of the skirt is made of flame-shaped tongues of yellow, orange and red rayon grosgrain each edged in gold thread, and tongues of gold and white crin. The skirt is also decorated with red feathers, and pieces of frayed red and yellow silk. At the back of the skirt are two wing shapes made of boned panels of gold, white and dark blue crin that are hand-painted red, pink and blue. The bodice has pink elastic shoulder straps and fastens with hooks and eyes. The skirt has crotch elastic. Worn with headdress ROH/PRO/COS/0000037 and earrings ROH/PRO/COS/0002345.
metadata.Condition: Good.The elastic of the shoulder straps has started to perish.
metadata.Creator: Natalia Goncharova

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of red rayon grosgrain decorated with feather-shaped lines of gold cord and hand-painted with a darker red. The central V panel of the bodice is decorated with appliquéd flat black crin and a panel of flat white crin threaded with gold thread and topped with gold braid along the centre. At two points on the neckline are plumes of thin red ostrich feathers. The bodice has two panels of black net at the back. The skirt has under layers of scallop-edged nylon netting graduating from yellow to orange, with a top layer of pink. The top layer of the skirt is made of flame-shaped tongues of red, orange, and yellow rayon grosgrain edged with gold braid and backed in net; tongues of flat translucent crin threaded with gold thread, similar to the bodice decoration; thin red feathers; and orange and yellow ribbons. Some tongues also have gold braid down the middle. At the back of the skirt are two wire wings covered with tongues of gold crin and white crin threaded with gold thread; both have gold braid down the centre. The tongues nearest the waist have been painted red. The bodice has pink elastic shoulder staps and fastens with hooks and eyes. There is an elastic strap in the gusset. Worn with headdress ROH/PRO/COS/0000037 and earrings ROH/PRO/COS/0002345.
metadata.Condition: Good.The red satin has faded, particularly the tongues. The skirt is rather crushed.
metadata.Creator: Natalia Goncharova

metadata.Description: Tutu with a boned bodice of pink fabric shot with gilt thread. The top edge of the bodice is trimmed with gold crin. The front neckline and the centre front are decorated with silver braid, iridescent leaf-shaped sequins, pink pearlised beads, diamantés on wires, and teardrop rhinestones. The basque has one layer of pink and two layers of pale green silk with scalloped edging trimmed with silver cord and decorated with diamanté. The cap sleeves are two layers of scalloped pink and green fabric mounted on white tulle and white net. The sleeves are trimmed with silver cord and decorated with iridescent leaf-shaped sequins, diamanté, gold sequins, and pearlised beads. The skirt is layers of pink net with pointed edges, decorated with silver sequins. The top layer is pale pink net edged with gold and white crin ribbon, silver tinsel, silver sequins, diamanté, beads. It has appliquéd fan-shaped panels of pleated tulle hand-painted pink and decorated with silver and gold sequins and diamanté. There are elastic shoulder straps, an elastic strap in the gusset, and a hoop in the skirt. (Note: The ballet was broadcast on 21 December 1958. The producer was Margaret Dale. Peter Wright provided additional choreography. Michael Somes was The Prince.)

The centre front panel of blue-dyed lurex brocade is edged with bands of salmon pink rayon that extend along the elastic shoulder straps, around the upper arms, and down the back (attached to the shoulder straps). The centre front panel is decorated with a motif of wired gilt cord and amber glass jewels. At the top left of the bodice is a decoration of frogging of wired gold cord and a gold painted tassel with beads. The small puffed sleeves of white cotton tarlatan are decorated with strips of white crin overlaid with wired gilt cord. The oval skirt has underlayers of pink cotton tulle and top layers of orange and pink silk organza. The overskirt of lurex brocade is decorated with white pompoms, green crin ribbon threaded with gold, and leaf shapes made from green lurex brocade and green cotton velvet. There is an elastic strap in the gusset and a hoop in the skirt.
metadata.Condition: Good.The skirt is crushed and dirty.
metadata.Creator: Oliver Messel

The oval skirt has layers of aquamarine net. The overskirt is aquamarine organza decorated with starfish, coral, and shells made of crin. There is an elastic strap in the gusset and a hoop in the skirt.

metadata.Description: Tutu with a chemise and short puffed sleeves of silver lurex and a boned corset of silver stretch lamé. The scooped neckline of the chemise is outlined in individually sewn silver balls and silver sequins. The corset has a trim of gold braid at the top and is decorated with diamanté, faux amber beads, silver circular and fleur-de-lys shaped sequins down the bodice and at the centre front and back. The botton edge of the bodice has a trim of silver foil edged in gold braid, and silver sequins. At the centre front is a large diamanté encircled with faux amber stones and outlined in gold braid. The underskirt is layers of pink scalloped nylon net overlaid with silver lurex decorated with silver sequins. There are two gold lurex embroidered lions rampant appliquéd to the centre front of the skirt, overlaid by a silver and black lurex short sword decorated with silver sequins. The skirt also has appliquéd decorations of silver lurex fleur-de-lys shapes sewn with silver sequins.
metadata.Creator: Lila de Nobili

The neckline is decorated with wired gold cord, faux pearls and diamanté drops extending up onto the elastic shoulder straps. The centre front is decorated with a panel of gold, green and peach braid, iridescent oval jewels, white crin, and diamanté drop jewels on wire. searchDocuments.title: University of Aberdeen Honorary Doctorate certificate presented to Ninette de Valois
searchDocuments.subtitle: Ninette de Valois Bequest | ROH/VAL/BEQ/21 | 1958

metadata.Description: The certificate reads in Latin: 'Universis et Singulis in quâcunque dignitate constitutis quorum haec nosse interest, Senatus Inclitae Universitatis Aberdonensis S.J.D.S Noveritis nos eâ auctoritatequam summi ac potentissimi Principes Mmae huic Universitati amplissimam indulsere Tabellarum praesentium Latorem, Eruditione Insignem, Ninettam de Valois Ex Senatus Academici decreto, promovente Juris Facultatis Decano, omnibus, quae dignitatis ratio aut Academiae consuetudo postulat, rite peractis Utriusque Juris tam Canonici quam Civilis Doctorem et Magistrum Constituisse, creâsse, proclamâsse, renunciâsse; Nec non eidem potestatem fecisse docendi, legendi, scribendi, commentandi, omniaque id genus alia praestandi, quae hic aut alibi uspiam Juris Canonici et Civilis Doctoribus et Magistris concedi solent; Omnibusque honoribus, dignitatibus, et privilegiis ipsum affecisse et ornâsse, quibus affici et ornari solent qui ad illum dignitatis gradum ullibi terrarum legitimâ ratione evehuntur. Quod ut felix faustumque sit, Deum ter Opt. Max. comprecamur. In cuius rei fidem Tabellas hasce communi Universitatis Sigillo et Chirographis idoneis muniendas curavimus Aberdoniae Anno Salutis MCMLVIII die Mensis, quarto Julii'.
metadata.Dimensions: (visible in mount) height 37 cm; (visible in mount) width 45 cm

The design on the right is a watercolour sketch of a mottled blue gown with pale pink detailing on the collar and skirt. Includes three small fabric swatches, a dark green cotton with a white sprig print, and two different dark blue cottons patterned with white flowers attached to the front of the design.

searchDocuments.title: Unsigned and undated costume design by Attilio Comelli - Grisettes in 'La bohème'
searchDocuments.subtitle: Attilio Comelli Design Collection | ROH/COM/DES/COS/0070

metadata.Description: Watercolour and pencil design for two Grisettes. The character on the left is depicted wearing pink hair ribbons, a pink gingham dress with a frilled hem, leg-of-mutton sleeves with white cuffs, and a wide collar, worn over a white blouse. The gown has a pink sash and is worn with a black apron. She wears a black shawl. The character on the right is depicted wearing a black frilly cap, a floral print gown of pale green, white, and pink, with a high collar, leg-of-mutton sleeves, and a frilled hem, and a cream pinafore apron. She wears a pink shawl. Includes two thumbnails detailing alternative bodices. One in mid-blue with a wide white collar, and the other a pale blue sailor-boy style bodice with dark blue trimming and bows. Includes two fabric swatches of a pink and white cotton gingham, and a white, pink and green floral print cotton attached to the front of the design. A handwritten note on the front of the design is unclear.
metadata.Condition: Good.The fabric swatches are still attached to the design board with the original large staples.
metadata.Creator: Attilio Comelli

searchDocuments.title: Unsigned and undated costume designs by Attilio Comelli - Grisettes in 'La bohème'
searchDocuments.subtitle: Attilio Comelli Design Collection | ROH/COM/DES/COS/0066

metadata.Description: Watercolour and pencil sketches for two Grisettes. The character on the left is depicted wearing a black frilly bonnet decorated with pink ribbon and a red flower, a salmon pink gown with leg-of-mutton sleeves, decorated with dark pink bows and braiding, and a wide white collar with a bow. Next to this design there is a thumbnail detailing the back of the bonnet showing the ribbon detail. The character on the right is depicted wearing a pale blue poke bonnet decorated with blue ribbons, a pale blue and white gown, with leg-of-mutton sleeves, a blue belt, a wide pale blue collar, and a high-necked white blouse. Next to this sketch are two thumbnails detailing the collar. Includes four fabric swatches, a cream cotton with pink flowers, a pink cotton with yellow and white flowers, a white cotton with blue flowers, and a pale blue cotton with a pale blue satin stripe attached to the front of the design.
metadata.Condition: Good.The fabric swatches are still attached to the design with the orignal large staples.
metadata.Creator: Attilio Comelli

searchDocuments.title: Unsigned and undated prop design by Attilio Comelli - Bed for 'Otello'
searchDocuments.subtitle: Attilio Comelli Design Collection | ROH/COM/DES/PRO/0001

metadata.Description: Watercolour and pencil prop design showing the side and end of a wooden four-poster bed with red and gold hangings. The wooden frame of the bed is elaborately decorated with a frieze of foliage around the top. The posts have an architectural appearance with ionic scrolls at the tops, the hangings are red with a gold decorative border, and the valance is red with a gold decorative pattern. The end of the bed is represented by a light pencil sketch.
metadata.Dimensions: of the board height 10.5 inches; of the board width 14.5 inches
